text: One of the factors of 5x^3 + 105x^2 + 540x is (x + b), where b is a positive constant. What is the smallest possible value of b?

Kenny engages in up to 3 types of exercise each week for a total of 6 hours while training for a triathlon. Kenny swims for the same number of minutes each week. The equation y = 360 - x - 170 represents the situation where Kenny bikes for x minutes during a week and runs for any remaining training time y, in minutes. If this equation is graphed in the xy-plane, which statement is the best interpretation of the y-intercept of the graph?

options.A: During a week when Kenny doesn't run, he bikes for 190 minutes.
options.B: During a week when Kenny doesn't bike, he runs for 190 minutes.
options.C: Each week, Kenny bikes and runs for a total of 190 minutes.
options.D: During a week when Kenny swims for 190 minutes, he bikes for 170 minutes.
